text:
marta_cs: Heads-up — ORCHID Finance submitted a model onboarding request. They want to serve a custom 13B fine-tuned model for risk summarization + credit-event scoring. Requirements: data isolation (VPC), PII redaction (no account numbers in outputs), and hallucination safeguards. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4729 :eyes:

ben_research: Nice, do we have the artifact and quantization details yet? Any evals from their side?

orchid_pm: We uploaded model.tar.gz (13B, fine-tuned). They ran basic metrics (accuracy/ROUGE) on a labeled dev set. Critical: outputs must never include raw account identifiers or internal risk flags. We'll need NDAs for IP as well.

sam_engineering: Ok — we'll need sample prompts and a labeled eval set (200–300 examples ideally). Also this will probably require either Dedicated or Private deployment (they want region isolation). @evan_solutions can you advise on SLA/pricing?

evans_solutions: (typo) Sorry, meant @evan_solutions

evans_solutions: jk :sweat_smile: @marta_cs I'll triage contract + renewal angle. For security: propose 30-day retention, no KV cache persistence for customer data. @sec_automation can you queue a model metadata scan?

sec_automation: Scan queued under run id cs-4729-scan. Please attach model hash + signed manifest. Required: pass tokenizer/embedding check, no executable code in metadata. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pii-redaction

ben_research: For evals I'll run: 1) safety/adversarial prompts (1k), 2) hallucination/regression tests (200 labeled), 3) perf baseline (latency/throughput on q4/8). Is 4-bit quant acceptable? Tradeoff on hallucination risk.

marta_cs: Customer prefers cheaper infra; 4-bit is fine if hallucination rate < 2.5% on critical prompts. Also flag: their renewal is in 4 weeks and they're considering a competitor because of latency — this onboarding ties directly to renewal.

orchid_pm: We need an NDA addendum for model IP and a weekly touchpoint. I can get the eval set uploaded by EOD.

sam_engineering: I'll draft a technical checklist + rollout plan. Proposed rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated rollback on quality regressions. Will add Redwood Optimize hooks for prompt-level monitoring. Example rollout config: ```yaml
model_variant: orchid-13b-ft
quant: q4_0
canary: 10%
monitoring: [perplexity, custom_accuracy, hallucination_rate]
```

evans_solutions: I'll prepare SOW with dedicated capacity pricing and SLA options; will also note renewal dependency and propose a pilot discount. @marta_cs can you confirm billing contact?

marta_cs: Confirmed. Next steps: @orchid_pm upload signed manifest + 200 labeled eval examples to S3 by EOW, @ben_research kick off safety eval, @sec_automation run model scan. I'll create a CS kickoff and schedule sync with the customer.

orchid_pm: Done — uploaded 220 eval examples to s3://orchid-onboarding/cs-4729 and attached signed manifest. Available for a kickoff Wed or Thu morning PT.

ben_research: Started safety eval run. Preliminary hallucination rate on their dev slices: 6.2% (unoptimized). Will iterate with prompt templates and post-processing filters, aim <2.5%. Will post a short results table when ready. :white_check_mark:

marta_cs: Great progress, thanks everyone. I'll keep CS ticket updated and flag renewal as high priority.

sec_automation: Security scan completed (metadata pass). Pending artifact static analysis and a final review after eval results.

sam_engineering: I'll prepare the canary infra config and a short runbook for the customer-facing devs. Planning deploy window next Friday if legal/scan clears.

orchid_pm: Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.
